answer_1.quote: REG can be divided into two distinct tasks: one-shot REG, finding a referring expression (RE) to single out a referent from a set, and REG-in-context, generating an RE to refer to a referent at a given point in a discourse.
answer_1.outputs: referring expressions (e.g., pronoun, proper name, description)

answer_2.quote: The main evaluation metric in the GREC-MSR shared tasks was accuracy. In addition to accuracy, we also report macro-F1 and weighted-macro F1.
